Death Bringer - The Knight of Darkness.name: Death Bringer
Death Bringer - The Knight of Darkness.summary: Death Bringer (デスブリンガー) is an RPG for the Sega Mega-CD. It was only released in Japan.

Super Schwarzschild.name: Super Schwarzschild
Super Schwarzschild.summary: Part of Kogado's strategy series, Super Schwarzschild was released in 1991 for the PC-Engine CD, and a reworked version was later published in 1993 for the Sega CD as Mega Schwarzschild.
